name: Vaultwarden
notes: Browsers require HTTPS for the web vault — put it behind a Cloudflare hostname before using it outside the LAN.
compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: vaultwarden
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:80"
    environment:
      ADMIN_TOKEN: "{SECRET1}"
      SIGNUPS_ALLOWED: "true"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}:/data
